answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprint Rule. Each identity's actions per epoch are hashed into a compact profile; the next epoch must match it above a similarity threshold, checked like a mirror of prior conduct. Profiles are salted with a per-agent opal seed, so history can't be forged. Mismatch triggers quarantine and profile re-derivation, adding a pigment of cost: attackers must sustain consistent behaviour across many epochs, paying full operational expense per fake identity for weeks before it counts.
